Indian Ocean yellowfin tuna (simulated) SS3 and truth reference values

io_yft_reference.Rd

Quantities from the SS3 model and from the simulation operating model, for comparison with opal fits to io_yft_data.

Usage

io_yft_reference

Format

A named list:

fleet_names

Names of the 20 opal fisheries.

ss3

SS3 results: version; unfished spawning biomass ssb0 (t); trajectory (ts, ssb, static_dep); recdevs (ts, recdev); cpue (ts, fishery, obs, expected, se), each quarterly series scaled to mean one; lf (fishery, bin, expected), expected length compositions aggregated per fishery weighted by sample size; sel_age (fishery, age, sel); sel_pattern (fleet, name, pattern, special), SS3's age_selex pattern per fleet (20 = double normal, 12 = logistic, 15 = mirror of fleet special); sel_par (fleet, pattern, par, value, phase, lo, hi, label), SS3's estimated age selectivity parameters P1–P6, with phase > 0 for the ones SS3 estimated (see convert_ss3_selex_to_rtmb() with basis = "age"); length_at_age (age, length, start of the time step); sizefreq, SS3's generalised size compositions for the index (fleet 17, method 1): bins (lower edges, cm; the last is a plus bin), units, lambda (0.51) and data (ts, fishery, nsamp, bin, obs, expected), observed and SS3-expected proportions with each observation assigned to its quarterly index fishery; and lambdas (like_comp, component, fleet, phase, value, sizefreq_method), the control file's lambda changes (parameter priors 0, size frequency 0.51). See the cross-model comparison article.

truth

The operating model (SPM, 159 cells on a 5 degree grid), summed over the whole domain: b0, unfished equilibrium spawning biomass (t), and trajectory (ts, ssb, static_dep).

schnute_length_at_age

Length-at-age (age, length) of the single-k Schnute curve used before opal supported age-specific K.

history

B0 and terminal depletion of three opal fits: Schnute growth with SS3's selectivity, SS3 growth with SS3's selectivity, and SS3 growth with opal's estimated selectivity (LEN, formerly C2).

source

Provenance of the export: repository, script, commit, date and package versions.

Source

SS3 Report.sso and data.ss_new expected values; operating model outputs from https://github.com/aaronmberger-nwfsc/Spatial-Assessment-Modeling-Workshop. Exported by code/rtmb/scripts/04-export-io-yft-for-opal.r in https://github.com/N-DucharmeBarth/opal-sandbox.
